integrity: Analytic proof uses complete two-orbit vertex description and a convex barycentric variance certificate. Exact rational finite checks corroborate 105 parameter triples; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The formulas apply only to canonical indicator-vector Euclidean panhandle base polytopes with integers 2 <= r < p and t >= 2; they do not assert general matroid or affine invariance. The prior minimal-matroid case \(p=r\) is excluded. Potential unindexed priority equivalence remains.
title: A sharp two-orbit minimum-sphere transition for panhandle matroid base polytopes
